population.discovery: identical to script/m14/ontology-coverage-gate.ts (git ls-files per repo, detectLanguageFromPath, 512 KB cap)
population.sliceMethod: deterministic stride over 1905 sorted walked paths, stride 4, first 600

rules.kind: incoming-check parity: name -> DISTINCT KINDS; ambiguous == >=2 kinds. B3 is unreachable under this rule BY CONSTRUCTION.
rules.store: parallel-indexer resolveRelationships: qualified-name exact first, then bare name accepted only when its SYMBOL count is 1; ambiguous == >1 symbol.
rules.why: 'ambiguous' is a property of a resolution rule, not of the corpus. A single number with no rule attached describes an unstated instrument.

unresolvedCauses.rule: store-rule hits; every unresolved target falls into exactly one of S1 spec vocabulary / S2 present in corpus text only / S3 absent from every admitted file / S4 path-shaped. NONE of the four is a lane-owned bucket: S2 cannot distinguish a usage from a declaration, and decl-inventory.mts measures the declaration question directly at 0 over 36,730 sites.
unresolvedCauses.s2IsNotADefect: decl-inventory.mts — same 1,905 admitted files, name collected at every grammar DECLARATION node, diffed against analyzer symbols: 36,730 sites, 11,745 distinct names, 0 declared-but-unpublished. S2 in this file is a USAGE/DEFINITION split, which is normal for split SDL.
unresolvedCauses.method: token-bounded scan of the concatenation of all admitted file texts (a name counts as mentioned only when neither adjacent character is a GraphQL delimiter), because a substring scan counts Type inside TypeName and would empty S2.
